coastal.title: SRO owner says City of Vancouver failed to act before Powell Street fire
coastal.description: “I asked him why he's not tearing it down and he said, well, I was never forced to tear it down, so the insurance wouldn't pay me to tear it down," Bob Fontaine said.

coastal.title: Nanaimo, B.C., takes steps to buy public art to commemorate city's lost Chinatowns
coastal.description: The creator of a public art installation that commemorates Nanaimo, B.C.'s former Chinatowns says she's pleased the city has taken steps towards purchasing the piece as part of its permanent collection.

kamloops.title: ‘God cleaned the slate’: Ashes pave the road to recovery after B.C. wildfires
kamloops.description: Joel Patan says his "life is ashes" now, as he sifts the ruins of his home that was incinerated last month, along with most structures in the small community of Faulder.

kamloops.title: Kamloops man finds rare mastodon tooth on B.C. Interior lakeshore
kamloops.description: A man from Kamloops, B.C., has unearthed a prehistoric fossil, marking only the third such discovery in British Columbia.

prince-george.title: Northeast B.C. faces warmer future and more extreme weather threats, researchers say
prince-george.description: A new report is forecasting a warmer and wetter future for northeastern B.C., as well as more extreme weather emergencies for local communities battered by some of the province's biggest natural disasters over the past decade.

prince-george.title: Outgoing Prince George city council delays major decision on new hockey rink, performing arts centre
prince-george.description: Prince George city council has delayed a major decision on next steps for a new downtown hockey rink and performing arts centre until after the municipal election.

all.title: As wildfire season winds down, people in B.C. communities are rebuilding their lives
all.description: As wildfire season winds down, British Columbia communities affected are now shifting to recovery efforts, while those who lost home sift through ashes and attempt to rebuild their lives.
